title: vscode-presets settings.local.json
description: Per-project settings, merged over the enabled presets by .vscode/install.sh. Any VS Code setting is allowed here; keys starting with vscodePresets. only configure install.sh.

vscodePresets.enabled.description: Presets for this project. The presets they require are added, and base is always on.

vscodePresets.runner.description: Command that runs something in the PHP container, used for the Symfony LSP, PHPUnit and the schema scripts. The kevin preset sets kevin app. It must contain a command, not only spaces.

vscodePresets.oroDocumentation.description: Folder of the local Oro documentation checkout, for the "Link Oro documentation" task. A leading ~ is expanded when the task runs.

vscodePresets.extensions.description: Extra extension IDs for the generated extensions.json.

vscodePresets.launch.description: Extra launch configurations, appended to the generated launch.json.

^vscodePresets\\.(?!enabled$|runner$|oro.description: Value for the {{name}} placeholder in a preset.

\\+$.description: Appends to the list that the presets built for the key without the +, instead of replacing it.
